newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to keep 51 pct stake in gold mine industry.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to keep 51 pct stake in gold mine industry.

text.p: The Ukrainian government has decided to keep tight control of its nascent gold mining industry, taking a 51 percent stake in all companies set up to develop deposits, and licensing gold mining activities.

The rule would apply to Ukrzoloto -- the company which has been set up to identify and explore gold deposits -- and any future mining companies set up, the cabinet of ministers said in a statement late on Monday.
Deputy Prime Minister Viktor Pynzenyk and Minister for Industry Policy and Energy Anatoly Minchenko had been told to prepare a draft decree on the subject, it said.
The statement said the government had noted a need to distribute special gold mining licences.
Ukraine has identified five gold deposits and is exploring three, mostly in the Trans-Carpathian region in the west of the former Soviet republic.
Industry Minister Valery Mazur has said the first year's gold production, planned for 1997, would total 900 kilos. Ukraine hopes to produce 12-15 tonnes a year in three to four years.
